profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software engineer with 5+ years of demonstrated experience developing .NET web applications. I having successfully modernized legacy applications; migrating them from on-prem to the cloud. My latest experience has been launching a new product from scratch which is now generating more than $100k MRR.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Architected and built our email-sending platform (ESP) on KumoMTA, Docker and Kubernetes. This covered DNS, DKIM, SPF, DMARC, custom return paths and bounce processing, through to warming up our sending IPs and onboarding clients.

* Migrated 30+ background workers and 8 APIs from Windows services to Kubernetes and .NET 10, with Docker build pipelines and autoscaling that responds to queue depth (KEDA).

* Built a self-hosted documentation site (docs.emailelement.com) with search and a built-in AI assistant and kept the docs and the assistant up to date with every feature release. It takes a skills-based approach with features such as continual learning with every new release, refinement, telemetry, and guardrails.

* Built EmailElement, a Unified Email Marketing Platform, growing it's ARR from $0 to over $1 million. The platform is currently sending over 10 million emails per day and multiplying.

* Migrated email delivery and engagement reports from SQL Server to ClickHouse, cutting the average report time from 20 seconds to under 1 second

* Implemented a multi-threaded webhook service ensuring email events are delivered to client's APIs, delivering more than 100k events per minute, and accounting for slow or non-functional client APIs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Implemented the entire billing subscription service, handling usage calculations, overages, custom plans, discounts, add-ons, and user notifications. Currently handling over tens of thousands of monthly recurring charges

* Developed a delivery event stream logging system for real-time monitoring and troubleshooting of email marketing campaigns. UI supports infinite scrolling/pagination and the ability to download millions of records of events in CSV format for analysis

* Secured two Web APIs using ASP.NET Core Identity with role-based and claim-based authentication, preventing unauthorized access. The authorization is granular allowing: no access, read-only access, or full access across different API endpoints

* Co-architected and built a highly scalable and dynamic email lifecycle journey, directing email recipients through unique marketing campaigns based on users’ metadata and/or previous interactions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Newport Beach, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
* Rebuilt a sequential legacy insurance eligibility service as parallelized Azure Durable Functions (fan-out/fan-in), reducing daily processing of 100K+ dental appointments from 24+ hours to under 6

* Incorporated a new 3rd-party payment system into legacy and modern .Net applications, increasing the company's expected yearly revenue by $50+ million

* Enhanced applications’ security and analytics, by upgrading numerous apps to take advantage of cloud resources such as Azure App Configuration, Azure Key Vault, and Azure Application Insights

* Co-Author and maintainer of a popular, organizational NuGet package, built as an SDK for a 3rd-party payment API; used throughout multiple teams and products across the organization

* Improved customer satisfaction, by automating dental services, using X12 EDI standards such as 837/835 (for claim submissions/payments) and 270/271 (for eligibility inquiries/responses)
positions.insights: Skills: Scrum · ASP.NET Web API · Microservices · C# · Troubleshooting · Problem Solving · ASP.NET MVC · Design Patterns · Azure · Bootstrap (Framework) · .NET Framework · Production Development · Back-End Web Development · JavaScript · Azure Key Vault · Azure Functions · ASP.NET · jQuery · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · Microsoft Azure · AngularJS · SQL · Debugging · Payment Systems · Microsoft SQL Server · Database Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Pioneered the company's first DevOps automation pipeline that built a C# automation framework and executed the test suites on in-lab diagnostic firmware

* Refactored the entire C# automation framework to shadow BDD principles and to function across all supported Window operating systems 

* Coached new interns on how to setup a CI/CD pipeline and on adding new test cases to our automation framework
positions.insights: Skills: Scrum · C# · Problem Solving · Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) · Test Automation · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
* Altered SQL database ORM models to better describe relationship between domain entities

* Created new API endpoints and assisted with swagger implementation to improve the API's documentation

* Added new Google Maps react component that mapped the distance between two locations on a grid
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · React.js · Problem Solving · Flask · Python (Programming Language) · API Development

positions.title: Junior QA Analyst
positions.description:
* Developed comprehensive test suites that thoroughly covered all business requirements

* Assisted and prioritized the resolution of critical defects

* Automated simple test cases written in Python and based on BDD principles
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) · Manual Testing · Test Automation · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Fulliment Associate
positions.description:
* Trained new hires, on effective and efficient ways of packing products

* Coordinated with management to ensure the team met daily requirements
